categorical.note: Use stable series identity; do not use categorical hue to communicate status.

semantic.note: Semantic tones are explicit intent and require text, labels, or shape in addition to color.

sequential.note: A sequential scale is a documented ordered use of the active chart ramp; it is not a second palette source.

diverging.note: The neutral midpoint and text labels remain available so direction is not inferred from hue alone.

geometry.note: Geometry and motion are shared roles; charts do not author local radius, shadow, timing, or measure systems.

LineChart.intent: Show change across an ordered dimension with one or more series.
consumerOwns: ordered labels, calculated series values, formatter, and business meaning
selection, filtering, and export authorization
ten4sevenOwns: series identity, state grammar, token mapping, responsive presentation, and accessible fallback
bounded SVG rendering and pointer/focus inspection behavior

useWhen: consumer-calculated data needs a bounded visual comparison or trend
a concise chart plus a textual summary improves a decision surface
avoidWhen: a table or list is the clearer primary representation
business formulas, fetching, or export authorization would be hidden in the renderer
adaptiveStrategy: reduce ticks and wrap or move the legend below on narrow surfaces
use native press/selection callouts rather than hover
ai.accessibilityAlternative: Expose an accessible name and concise data summary; provide a list or table alternative when point-level access matters.

AreaChart.reason: Area fill is a rendering mode of an ordered trend; the existing LineChart already owns the series, state, tooltip, and accessibility contract.
AreaChart.aiGuidance: Use LineChart with an area presentation option when a bounded implementation exposes it; do not add AreaChart as another primitive.

ColumnChart.reason: Column orientation changes presentation, not categorical comparison intent.
ColumnChart.aiGuidance: Use BarChart with an orientation variant only after the renderer supports it; do not create a second API.

PieChart.reason: A pie is the same bounded whole-to-part contract without the center treatment.
PieChart.aiGuidance: Prefer DonutChart or a future presentation variant; do not create a duplicate distribution primitive.

StackedBar.reason: Part-to-whole stacking needs a deliberate series/axis/accessibility contract and must remain behind an approved renderer boundary.
StackedBar.aiGuidance: Use BarChart only for the current bounded single-value contract; defer stacked rendering until an adapter is approved.

Scatter.reason: Point density, axes, selection, and accessible alternatives require a chart engine contract.
Scatter.aiGuidance: Do not recreate a scatter engine in consumer code; use the future normalized adapter after engine, performance, and accessibility review.

Bubble.reason: Magnitude encoded by area needs a tested scale, labels, collision strategy, and non-visual alternative.
Bubble.aiGuidance: Defer Bubble until the advanced visualization adapter and data-list alternative are proven.

Radar.reason: Radial axes and dense labels are not justified by the current bounded chart renderer.
Radar.aiGuidance: Prefer a table or grouped BarChart until a specific advanced adapter is approved.

Gauge.reason: A gauge needs explicit bounds, target meaning, status semantics, and a textual value; it is not a decorative progress ring.
Gauge.aiGuidance: Use Progress or MetricCard for current bounded signals; defer Gauge until its semantic contract is approved.

Heatmap.reason: A matrix intensity surface needs scale, missing-cell, keyboard, contrast, and large-data behavior behind an adapter.
Heatmap.aiGuidance: Do not use arbitrary gradients or hardcoded cells; defer to an approved heatmap adapter with a table alternative.

ComboChart.reason: Mixed series and multiple axes materially increase scale, legend, and accessibility complexity.
ComboChart.aiGuidance: Prefer separate bounded charts or a future normalized combo adapter; never hide multiple business units in a consumer-local chart.

SalesLineChart.reason: Business subject does not create a new chart primitive.
SalesLineChart.aiGuidance: Use LineChart and keep sales data, calculation, and labeling in the consumer recipe.

FarmBarChart.reason: Farm is a product profile/domain composition, not a chart renderer.
FarmBarChart.aiGuidance: Use BarChart inside the Farm recipe; do not add a Farm-specific chart component.

RevenueDonut.reason: Revenue meaning belongs to consumer data and profile composition, not a new visual primitive.
RevenueDonut.aiGuidance: Use DonutChart with consumer-owned currency formatting and accessible summary.

ChartTooltip.reason: Tooltip behavior is a chart support contract and should remain shared with overlay positioning, not a donor API.
ChartTooltip.aiGuidance: Use the chart's shared tooltip behavior; future public tooltip exports must be normalized through Ten4Seven.

ChartToolbar.reason: Export, zoom, and filter controls need consumer authorization and an explicit interaction contract.
ChartToolbar.aiGuidance: Compose existing Toolbar and actions when needed; do not add chart-specific controls until the behavior is bounded.

DataLabel.reason: Labels are an annotation policy that must not collide or duplicate the accessible summary.
DataLabel.aiGuidance: Prefer formatter, legend, tooltip, or data-list alternatives until an engine adapter owns label placement.

t7-svg-charts.capability: bounded LineChart, BarChart, DonutChart, Sparkline, legend, tooltip, and lifecycle states
t7-svg-charts.bundleImplication: already included in the existing @ten4seven/ui Web bundle; U08 adds no chart dependency
t7-svg-charts.isolationBoundary: renderer implementation behind semantic chart props; consumers pass data and formatters only
t7-svg-charts.vendorApiPolicy: No vendor API is exposed; engineOptions is not accepted by the current bounded renderer.

native-chart-renderer.capability: native chart rendering from the shared series/state/token intent with press callouts and data-list alternative
native-chart-renderer.dependency: future native consumer or approved native chart engine; none selected in U08
native-chart-renderer.license: not assessed until a concrete engine is proposed
native-chart-renderer.bundleImplication: must be lazy/optional for native consumers and must not inflate @ten4seven/ui Web consumers
native-chart-renderer.isolationBoundary: @ten4seven/native descriptor/projection boundary; no React Native component is created in U08
native-chart-renderer.vendorApiPolicy: Any future engineOptions stays inside the adapter and is never part of the Ten4Seven semantic contract.

scheduler-engine-adapter.capability: event placement, overlap, resource headers, time grids, navigation, and optional drag/resize support
scheduler-engine-adapter.dependency: no scheduler dependency selected; current Calendar remains a date-selection renderer
scheduler-engine-adapter.license: not assessed until a concrete engine is proposed
scheduler-engine-adapter.bundleImplication: must be a lazy optional boundary; no scheduler code is added to the current UI package in U08
scheduler-engine-adapter.isolationBoundary: normalized scheduler event/view/state contract with consumer-owned truth and timezone policy
scheduler-engine-adapter.vendorApiPolicy: No FullCalendar, donor, or provider API is canonical; adapter-only options remain private to a future engine wrapper.

map-engine-adapter.capability: tiles, projection, markers, clustering, routes, polygons, heatmaps, and provider controls
map-engine-adapter.dependency: no map dependency selected; no production geolocation or provider integration in U08
map-engine-adapter.license: not assessed until provider, tiles, privacy, and licensing are approved
map-engine-adapter.bundleImplication: must be lazy/optional and provider-isolated; no map dependency is added to Web or native packages in U08
map-engine-adapter.isolationBoundary: normalized map overlays/coordinates plus list alternative; provider objects never cross the contract plane
map-engine-adapter.vendorApiPolicy: No Mapbox, Leaflet, MapLibre, or provider object/API is canonical; provider options remain inside a future adapter.

chart.sourceContract: LineChart/BarChart/DonutChart/Sparkline semantic series and chart state contract
chart.accessibilityAlternative: Native chart summary plus an ordered data list or table when point-level inspection is required.
consumerOwns: calculated values, business meaning, selection, and export policy

scheduler.accessibilityAlternative: Ordered agenda with event title, explicit start/end, status, resource, and action labels.
consumerOwns: event truth, permissions, availability, conflicts, booking, persistence, and timezone policy

map.accessibilityAlternative: Named map region with a synchronized accessible marker or route list; selected locations are stated in text.
consumerOwns: coordinates, provider, permissions, geocoding, route truth, privacy, and business geography

timezone.storedValue: consumer-defined canonical instant or local business value
timezone.note: A renderer must not silently convert or relabel event times across timezones.

compatibility: LineChart, BarChart, DonutChart, and Sparkline remain the existing bounded chart family; variants do not increase canonical component count.
Calendar and DatePicker remain date-selection contracts and are not Scheduler implementations.
ActivityFeed and Timeline remain chronological narrative display; they are not TimelineScheduler or event-placement engines.
No domain-specific SalesLineChart, FarmBarChart, RevenueDonut, CustomerMap, DeliveryMap, or FarmMap component is permitted.
Missing data is not zero: null/undefined/invalid values remain distinguishable from a present zero and may resolve to partialData.
Web may project the same roles to CSS variables; native consumes resolved typed values and canary metadata without parsing CSS.
No Recharts, ECharts, FullCalendar, Mapbox, Leaflet, MapLibre, or other donor/provider API is exposed by this contract.
U08 adds no heavy visualization, scheduler, map, native UI, geolocation, or DnD dependency.
